candidates.subject: pgvector_queries_use
candidates.statement: pgvector queries use an isolated pool of 5 connections with statement timeouts capped at 15 seconds.
candidates.evidence_quote: We decided that pgvector queries must run with an isolated pool of 5 connections and statement timeouts capped at 15 seconds.

candidates.subject: production_requires_sslmode=verify-full
candidates.statement: Production requires sslmode=verify-full and rejects sslmode=disable.
candidates.evidence_quote: production TLS certificate verification is mandatory using sslmode=verify-full. We will reject any connection string that uses sslmode=disable.
